name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare
description: Enables deployment of MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers with OAuth authentication, allowing remote access to MCP tools via SSE transport. Includes example math tools and supports connection from Claude Desktop and MCP Inspector.
